page.title: Fuel.
page.intro: AI-generated weekly plan, kept inside the brand frame. Olive oil and butter, not rapeseed oil. Skyr and cottage cheese, not protein bars. Whole foods.
page.kcalAdjustBody: We've adjusted your daily calorie target {sign}{delta} kcal{reason}. Based on your weight trend over the last 14 days.
page.quotaBody: You've used your quota for {label} actions ({dailyUsed}/{dailyMax} today, {weeklyUsed}/{weeklyMax} this week).
page.emptyTitle: Set the frame, and the AI builds.
page.emptyBody: Once you've set allergies, dislikes and preferred ingredients, we generate a weekly plan with 21 meals, a shopping list and a prep schedule.
page.supplementsBody: We always recommend getting it from food. These are the exceptions where it's hard or expensive to get enough from the plate alone.

logMeal.photoTitle: Snap a photo of the plate
logMeal.photoHint: Optional · the AI compares the photo with the plan
logMeal.notesPlaceholder: e.g. swapped chicken for tofu, no avocado in the store

preferences.title: What you eat.
preferences.intro: Set the frame once. The AI stays inside it — no rapeseed oil, no UPF, no guessing.
preferences.householdHint: Number of people you cook for
preferences.fishHint: The Danish Health Authority target is 2-3
preferences.mealPrepHint: Reuse 2-3 meals strategically across the week (same lunch Monday + Wednesday, same dinner Tuesday + Thursday). Fewer unique meals = less prep + shopping.
preferences.mealPrepCheckbox: Reuse meals for a Sunday batch-cook
preferences.allergiesHint: Hard-stop. The AI never puts them on the plate. Separate with commas.
preferences.dislikesHint: Avoided when there are alternatives. Separate with commas.
preferences.preferencesHint: Boost. The AI picks these more often, all else equal.
preferences.preferencesPlaceholder: e.g. chicken, rye bread, citrus, tangy

setup.metaTitle: Set up your meal plan — MakeIt
setup.title: Set the frame.
setup.intro: Four choices — then the AI generates your first week with recipes, macros and a shopping list. You can adjust everything later under settings.
setup.goalSub: We tune calories and protein to the direction.
setup.goalCutSub: Lose fat while keeping your muscle mass.
setup.goalRecompSub: Trade fat for muscle — same weight, different body.
setup.goalMaintainSub: Performance and recovery at the center.
setup.goalMassSub: Put on size in controlled steps.
setup.dietSub: We only pick proteins and recipes that match.
setup.dietOmnivoreSub: Everything on the table — meat, fish, eggs, plants.
setup.dietPescatarianSub: Fish and plants, no land animals.
setup.dietVegetarianSub: Dairy, eggs and plants — no meat.
setup.cookingTitle: How much do you want to cook?
setup.cookingSub: Controls how advanced the recipes we pick are.
setup.cookingBasicSub: 20 min or less per meal, no special equipment.
setup.cookingIntermediateSub: OK with 30-45 min and a bit of prep on the weekend.
setup.cookingAdvancedSub: Happy to spend more time + technique — sous vide, low-roast, all of it.
setup.weightSub: We use it to aim calories + protein right. You can update it weekly on the dashboard.
setup.weightTiming: Best timing: morning, fasted, after the toilet
setup.submitTiming: Takes 5-10 sec · Claude builds the week

shopping.title: What goes in the cart.
shopping.intro: The whole week's ingredients, gathered and scaled to your household. Tap to check them off as you walk the store.
shopping.noPlanBody: The shopping list builds on the week's meals — so start by laying down the plan.
shopping.footerNote: Quantities are rounded — no need for precision down to 7g of red onion. Check the pantry before you head out; you've probably got most of the spices.

shoppingChecklist.empty: No ingredients in this week's plan.

logWeight.noWeight: No weigh-in yet. Log your first to get personalized macros.

planOverlay.stage2: Picking meals that match your goal
planOverlay.title: Building your plan.
planOverlay.overtime: Taking a little longer than usual — falling back to a rule-based plan shortly
planOverlay.stayOnPage: Stay on the page — no need to refresh

skipDays.body: Mark days where you eat out, travel or fast. The planner skips them on the next generation — adherence stats won't count them against you.
skipDays.regenHint: Regenerate the weekly plan to remove meals from marked days

streak.copy3: Three days in a row. The habit is starting to set.
streak.copy7: A whole week. It's not random anymore.
streak.copy14: Fourteen days. Most people drop off here — not you.
streak.copy30: Thirty days. It's a lifestyle now, not an experiment.
